segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the final scope for the calibration management subscription and make sure the start date and seat count are right before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 28 standard users and 4 admins. That covers quality, maintenance, and the two lab leads. We don’t need seats for operators yet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 32 total named users, with 4 admin permissions. The annual subscription is $38,400, and the one-time implementation package is $6,200. That includes the instrument import, two remote training sessions, and the calibration due-date workflow setup.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The price matches what we reviewed. Can you make the subscription start August 1? Our current process runs through July, and finance wants the invoice dated after the new budget opens.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, August 1 start, 12-month term through July 31 next year. Invoice issued August 1, net 30. And billing contact is still Marisol in AP, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. marisol dot king at our company. Also, can you note that we need the asset upload template by July 10? We have about 1,180 gauges and meters to clean up.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, asset template by July 10 is included. For go-live, we’re targeting September 3, with admin training the week of August 19 and user training the following week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. One thing, our VP asked whether the support coverage includes audit week. We have our ISO audit September 16 to 18.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does. Standard support is business hours, and implementation support will still be active then. I’ll list the audit dates in the kickoff notes so the services team knows to keep an eye on response times that week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and copy procurement. If it matches this, I can sign by Friday.
